_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. dailyartmagazine.com is a single-theme WordPress magazine: a white editorial field with #19191c dark bands (top nav, hero, mid-page sections) and a #c6002f crimson accent. The theme declares only stock WordPress --wp--preset--* variables, so design values are measured computed styles, wp presets are var-referenced where declared.

sans.source: computed fontFamily of nav-link, art-para, nl-send (raw/components-computed.json); @font-face Basier in idvetmp-child style.css
sans.description: Basier — every UI string, body copy, buttons, chips, meta.

display.description: RoslindaleCondensed — hero/article 56px, section headings 32px, feed tabs 28px.

narrow.source: computed fontFamily of post-card-title, cat-nav-item (raw/components-computed.json); @font-face RoslindaleNarrow in style.css

semibold.description: 600 — nav links, buttons, card meta labels.

menu.description: The rgba(0,0,0,.25) 0 16px 48px drop under the mega-menu.

hover.description: The hover fill transition shared by the ghost buttons.

ink.description: The #000 ink on every light-surface heading and label.

accent.description: The #c6002f crimson — chips, tags, ghost-button borders, footer links, hover fills.

accent-ghost-border.description: The 1px #c6002f border of the ghost buttons (Search, Send, Load more).

hairline-dark.description: The #2e2e32 dark hairline — menu-item rules and the hero-tag flanking lines.

submit-border.description: The #989da7 grey border on the black contact-submit button.

load-more-height.description: The 38px full-width Load more ghost button.

nl-checkbox-input.description: The 13px invisible input box (opacity:0); the painted checkbox is the label's ::after.

nl-checkbox-box.source: entered by hand at capture time, not measured: a probe of the .checkbox-style label's ::after (16x16 #fff, 1px solid #989da7, 2px radius) was never saved to raw/; raw/components-computed.json holds only the 13x13 input (nl-checkbox); recapture needed
nl-checkbox-box.description: The 16px painted checkbox box (white, 1px #989da7 border, 2px radius) — the 13px input is opacity:0.

chip-flanking-rule.description: The 41x1 #2e2e32 rules the hero tag paints on both sides.

ghost-dark-track.source: computed styles of search-btn across states (raw/components-computed.json)
ghost-dark-track.description: Ghost button on the dark bar (Search): transparent + 1px #c6002f border with WHITE text at rest, fills #c6002f on hover/pressed.

nav-link-state-track.source: computed styles of nav-link across states (raw/components-computed.json)
